nodes.name: scc_config_clean_scoped.ini
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a clean, well-scoped SCC Principal Propagation configuration with templated CN (${user_uuid}), email-domain condition, 60-minute certificate validity, and LOCAL propagation mode. Used to assert that the SCC analyzer reports no critical findings on safely scoped configs.
nodes.languageNotes: Despite the .ini extension, content is XML — SCC stores commonConfigData as XML.

nodes.name: scc_config_critical_empty.ini
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a CRITICAL-severity SCC Principal Propagation misconfiguration: empty subjectPatterns element allows any subject to be issued a short-lived certificate. Used to validate that the analyzer flags missing identity scoping.

nodes.name: scc_config_critical_name.ini
nodes.summary: Test fixture with a CRITICAL-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: CN bound to the unscoped ${name} placeholder with no condition, allowing impersonation across users. Drives the analyzer's identity-attribute heuristics.

nodes.name: scc_config_high_email.ini
nodes.summary: Test fixture with a HIGH-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: CN bound to ${email} without a scoping condition; email collisions or aliases enable lateral identity. Used to validate medium-strength identity binding detection.

nodes.name: scc_config_high_hardcoded_ddic.ini
nodes.summary: Test fixture with a HIGH-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: CN hardcoded to the SAP standard user DDIC, granting any propagated session DDIC's privileges on the backend. Validates detection of hardcoded high-privilege identity binding.

nodes.name: scc_config_medium_long_validity.ini
nodes.summary: Test fixture with a MEDIUM-severity SCC Principal Propagation finding: scoped CN (${user_uuid}/OU=HR) is safe but certificateValidityPeriodInMins=1440 and ssoToleranceInHours=24 exceed recommended values. Validates time-window heuristics.

nodes.name: trustcfg_single_xsuaa.xml
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing an SCC trustConfiguration with a single XSUAA IdP entry (subaccount + default-jwt-key). Public key is a placeholder. Used to validate trust-store parsing and single-IdP rendering paths.

nodes.name: trustcfg_xsuaa_plus_ias.xml
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing an SCC trustConfiguration with two enabled IdPs — XSUAA and IAS — for the same subaccount. Used to validate the analyzer's multi-IdP enumeration and reporting of mixed trust chains.
